1: Sarah is 15th in line and each green lets 7 cars through. Cars 1–7 go on the first green and 8–14 on the second, so she goes on the third. Wait = 42 + 10 + 42 + 10 + 42 = 146 s = 2 min 26 s — D.
2: 'Works only if X; not X, so not working' correctly uses a necessary condition. E has the same form: he travels only for a wedding, there is no wedding, so he won't travel — E.
3: The argument concludes that lower speed limits should be imposed to tackle pollution from brakes, tyres and road surfaces. That only works if lower speeds reduce that pollution — E.
4: Home beekeeping adds competition for wild pollinators and gives honey bees an unfair advantage. So it isn't always ecologically beneficial — B.
5: Arrive at Newtown by 10:00 − 20 (taxi) − 15 (walk) = 09:25, so take the 08:00 train. Be at the station by 07:50, so leave home at 07:35 — A.
7: A centre dot can only be left from 1, 3 or 5. A corner dot can be from 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6. 9 = 3×3, 10 = 5×2, 12 = 3×4 and 20 = 5×4 are possible, but 8 would need an even first die — A.
8: Sleeping more is associated with dying, but sick people may sleep more because they are dying. The argument treats correlation as causation — E.
9: Information alone doesn't remove all excuses. If financial and other obstacles stop people staying healthy, the conclusion fails — C.
10: People should give up personal data for the benefit of a fairer society. D applies this to DNA databases for crime solving — D.
11: Two of each coin = 334p. 241p left in as few coins as possible: 2 × £1 + 3 × 10p + 1 × 5p + 3 × 2p = 9 coins. 10 + 9 = 19 — C.
12: 3 six-packs for £8 = 18 animals, then 2 single six-packs for £6 = 12, then a single animal for £1. 18 + 12 + 1 = 31 for £15 — D.
13: Takings = customers × average spend. Read the bar heights: 11:00–12:00 has many customers but the lowest average spend, giving the smallest product — C.
14: The promise of brain training hasn't been substantiated: gains are task-specific and the studies are weak — B.
15: Young people use A&E because they can't get family doctor appointments at suitable times. Longer opening hours would therefore relieve A&E — C.
